name: quill-desktop
description: Hold a key, speak, let go — the words land where your caret already is. Windows, Linux and macOS.
author: Roman Gigliotti

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac
